Four of 12 omitted root members have source-backed dispositions, three CE behavior associations remain target-unverified, and eight *_unused ranges remain semantically open. Compiler-selected member extents cover all 54 nested schema-unrepresented ranges with zero uncovered byte intervals; all 54 semantic dispositions remain open. All 41 serialized block/data fields empty in at least one audited retail BSP have synthetic structural fixtures; consumer semantics remain unproven. Member-specific artifacts cover all 164 rows including three zero-size nonserialized check sentinels; behavioral fixtures name 58 rows. The paired PCSX2 target probe qualifies its named collision/PVS/path rows on 13 MP maps. None of these counts closes opaque byte semantics.
